The '''Natalon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Piryn Shar sector/Legends|Piryn Shar sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected it to the [[Noe'ha'on system/Legends|Noe'ha'on]] and [[Har system]]s.<ref name="TEA" />

The Natalon system was the origin point of [[Natalon Core Bandits]].<ref name="ValentineStory" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was involved in a [[Lightfight|shootout]] within the system at some point between [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Natalon system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-16.<ref name="TEA" />
